code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated RDW, monocytosis, basophilia, elevated ferritin, increased creatinine, mild hyperchloremia, low CO₂, and elevated INR. These findings suggest possible acute or chronic hypoxic and inflammatory processes, impaired renal function, and bone marrow suppression or dysfunction. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended to determine underlying causes such as infection, inflammation, or hematologic disorder.
